title: Use Seedance 2.5 in CapCut with 2 reference images plus a Chinese-language…
content: Use Seedance 2.5 in CapCut with 2 reference images plus a Chinese-language prompt to generate a mythological fight video (e.g., Sun Wukong vs The Buddha).
tips: Use Seedance 2.5 in CapCut with 2 reference images plus a Chinese-language prompt to generate a mythological fight video (e.g., Sun Wukong vs The Buddha).
